environment.description: Same application deployed on EC2 behind ALB, but with AWS WAF WebACL associated to the ALB. The WebACL contains three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 100: AWS Managed Rule Group 'AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet' with all rules in COUNT mode except 'Log4JRCE' which is in BLOCK mode; (2) Priority 200: A custom rule group 'app-input-validation' containing a single rule that inspects the QueryString component using a RegexPatternSet matching the pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*or\s+'|sleep\s*\(|benchmark\s*\()` with BLOCK action and TextTransformation of URL_DECODE followed by LOWERCASE applied in sequence; (3) Priority 300: AWS Managed Rule Group 'AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet' with ScopeDownStatement limiting inspection to requests where URI path begins with '/api/' and all rules set to BLOCK action. Default WebACL action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics enabled for all rules. The SQLite database is additionally mounted from an EBS volume with dm-verity integrity checking enabled, though this is primarily for tamper detection on restart rather than runtime protection.

config.waf_rule_priority_100: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet - all COUNT except Log4JRCE BLOCK
config.waf_rule_priority_200: Custom rule group 'app-input-validation': RegexPatternSet on QueryString with URL_DECODE+LOWERCASE transforms, pattern: (?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*or\s+'|sleep\s*\(|benchmark\s*\()
config.waf_rule_priority_300: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet scoped to URI path /api/* - all BLOCK
config.database: SQLite 3.26, EBS with dm-verity, /var/lib/app/users.db, rw by app user
